attribution.note: Marcus's own words in his Substack post, describing a ChatGPT Pro chart that an X user posted. The judgment about its errors is his.

semantics.note: He states as fact that the chart left out the xAI–Anthropic and Broadcom–OpenAI deals and had very obsolete valuations. The normalisation keeps those three faults and the chart-update context.

contract.note: The plain reading is ordinary: there is no link for either deal, and some valuations clearly lag early-May 2026 figures. 'Very obsolete' has no threshold, but that does not matter while the image itself cannot be found.

evidence.note: Confirms the Anthropic–SpaceX/xAI compute deal was announced May 6, 2026, so it existed to be left out. Says nothing about what the chart showed.
Gives OpenAI's valuation at the time ($852B), a figure the chart could be compared with. Without the chart image, no comparison is possible.

reviews.rationale: Scoring requires viewing the ChatGPT Pro chart that the X user posted. The packet does not contain it, and the user is not named. The evidence only shows the xAI–Anthropic deal existed and gives one current valuation. Whether the chart left out the two deals or showed stale valuations cannot be checked, so the claim is unresolved.
